title: Evaluating DNA damage response through immunofluorescence staining of primordial germ cells in Caenorhabditis elegans L1 larva
protocol: Synchronize worms with genetic background of interest at the L1 larval stage before treatment.
Plate fixed number of L1 worms (suspended in M9 buffer) in NGM plates corresponding to the area of plates.
Initiate treating process as required and incubate worms at 20°C after feeding worms with concentrated OP 50.
Harvest worms at the desired time point by rinsing plates with M9 buffer and collect in a sealed 15-mL tube.
Centrifuge collected worms at 800–1000 × g for 2–3 min to spin down worms.
Centrifuge samples carefully to avoid retaining excessive bacteria that may interfere with further procedures and cause background issues after staining.
Remove supernatant without disturbing settled worms.
Prepare Fixing buffer according to the required volume.
Aliquot 5 μl of Fixing buffer into a 0.2-mL tube.
Transfer 5 μl of worms to the 0.2-mL tube containing Fixing buffer and mix gently with pipetting five times.
Transfer 5 μl of worm-Fixing buffer mixture to a HistoBond®+ Adhesion Microscope slide (with one ring white).
Attach a 24 × 24-mm coverslip to the drop, preferably unparallel to the slide.
Press around the edge of the coverslip while incubating for 2 min at 20°C–22°C.
Move slides carefully into the box with dry ice and leave for at least 10 minutes or until thoroughly frozen.
Prechill 100% methanol in a coplin jar at -20°C.
Take out frozen slide and flip the coverslip using fingertip when still frozen.
Immediately immerse the slide in ice cold methanol and incubate for 10 min.
Remove slides from methanol.
Wash slides in a staining container with PBST buffer for 10 minutes.
Repeat washing with refreshed PBST buffer two more times.
Block slides with 50 μl PBST containing 10% donkey serum for 30 minutes at 20°C–22°C in a humid chamber.
Dilute CEP-1 antibody in PBST with 10% donkey serum at a dilution of 1:300.
Dilute PGL-3 antibody in PBST with 10% donkey serum at a dilution of 1:10000.
Dilute RAD-51 in PBS to a concentration of 1:350.
Incubate slides with 50 μl of diluted RAD-51 in a humid chamber at 4°C for at least 16 hours.
Wash slides in PBST buffer for 10 minutes.
Repeat washing with refreshed PBST twice more for a total of three washes.
Remove excessive solution from slides by wiping around the white ring with kimwipes.
Dilute secondary antibodies in PBST with 10% donkey serum according to primary antibody requirements and desired detecting channels.
Incubate slides with diluted secondary antibodies at 20°C-22°C for 2 hours in a humid, light-protective chamber.
Wash slides in PBST buffer for 10 minutes three times.
Remove excessive solution from slides by wiping around the white ring with kimwipes.
Place a coverslip compatible with confocal microscopy on a flat surface.
Apply approximately 15 μl of DAPI Fluoromount-G® mounting medium onto the coverslip.
Apply the slide with specimen side gently on the mounting medium until the medium disperses over the whole area.
Place the mounted slide with specimen facing-up in a light-protective chamber or drawer.
Leave for 24 hours or until the mounting medium is dry.
Seal the slides with durable sealing reagent such as coverslip sealant or nail polish.
Store slides light-protected at 4°C if imaged in few days, or store slides at −20°C for extended storage.
